items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: He was very talented. I used to hear the bands come from New York when I was a kid you know in highschool.

ctx.x: He had most of the good white players Red Nichols did. There were few very talented white players. White in quotes because people like Jack Teagarden. If you ever saw Jack Teagarden you'd know he was part African too. He was never considered that. He was very talented.
I used to hear the bands come from New York when I was a kid you know in highschool. I was tuned in on the Casa Loma Orchestra.
